entities.title: Three zones, 2026 and 2027 only
entities.summary: The bundle knows America/New_York, Europe/Paris and Atlantic/Reykjavik from 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z (inclusive) to 2028-01-01T00:00:00Z (exclusive), and nothing else.
entities.impact: Fixtures and example tests can only use those zones and years; any other zone or instant resolves to unsupported (unknown-zone, outside-rule-window), never an extrapolation.
entities.workaround: An application loads a pinned tzdb release through the library's rule loader instead.
